parsed.name: BioShake 恒温振荡器
parsed.description: 用于生物样品的加热与振荡装置，能够对振荡速度/加速度/减速度进行设置，并进行温度设定与控温；可对样品板（夹具/载板）进行锁定以保证运行稳定。
parsed.description_en: A heater-shaker device for biological samples. It supports setting shaking speed, acceleration, and deceleration, as well as temperature setpoints with active temperature control. It can lock the sample plate/holder for stable operation.

actions.description: 初始化并做好运行准备（可选择先复位后归位）。
actions.description_en: Initialize the device and prepare it for operation (optionally reset first, then home).

actions.description: 将振荡器初始化到归位位置。
actions.description_en: Move/initialize the shaker to its home position.

actions.description: 对 BioShake 进行复位，以清理状态并恢复到可运行的初始条件。
actions.description_en: Reset the BioShake to restore it to a ready initial state.

actions.description: 开始振荡，并设置振荡速度与加速度（可按设备指令选择带/不带时长启动）。
actions.description_en: Start shaking with a specified speed and acceleration (according to the device command, with or without duration).

actions.description: 停止振荡，并可设置减速度。
actions.description_en: Stop shaking, optionally with a specified deceleration.

actions.description: 锁定样品板/载板夹具以固定样品位置。
actions.description_en: Lock the sample plate/holder to secure the sample position.

actions.description: 解锁样品板/载板夹具以便取放样品。
actions.description_en: Unlock the sample plate/holder to allow loading or unloading samples.

actions.description: get 是否支持锁板功能。
get 是否支持主动制冷的控温模式。
actions.description_en: get whether active cooling is supported for temperature control.

actions.description: 设置目标温度并启动控温。
actions.description_en: Set a target temperature and start temperature control.
